up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, and indication details (MeSH heading and EFO term) for all approved drugs indicated for multiple myeloma. Join molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, and compound_structures on molregno. Filter for approved status (max_phase >= 4). Filter indications where mesh_heading or efo_term contains 'multiple myeloma' (case-insensitive). Return all matching rows without ranking or limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase >= 4 AND (LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%multiple myeloma%' OR LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%multiple myeloma%')
